$description: Ember & Ash implementation tokens for apps/ui. Only tokens the code references are kept.

on-surface-muted.$description: Low-emphasis ink on the dark elevated surfaces (4.83:1 on surface). Code fence comments and code fence chrome use it. text-muted is the light-page counterpart and measures 1.4:1 here.

page-background.$description: Current light page background used by implemented routes.

accent.$description: Interactive rose accent used by current implemented routes.

accent-hover.$description: Hover ink for inline links. Same value as accent-strong.

accent-strong.$description: Accent for small text and for fills that carry white text (6.46:1 both ways). Use accent itself for 24px+ text, borders, focus rings, and anything on a dark surface.

accent-tint.$description: Fill behind the AI summary callout on the light page. AI-written text sits on it so it never reads as the vault note. No other light-page element uses a fill.

caution.$description: Line and label ink for warning-type callouts in post bodies. Amber so a warning never reads as the red accent. 5.93:1 on page-background.

text-muted.$description: Low-emphasis label ink on page-background (5.04:1). Previously an alias of on-surface-variant, a dark-theme ink that measured 1.7:1 here.

terminal-red.$description: MacOS terminal control color used only for terminal chrome.

terminal-yellow.$description: MacOS terminal control color used only for terminal chrome.

terminal-green.$description: MacOS terminal control color used only for terminal chrome.

terminal-output-error.$description: Landing terminal error lines. Amber so errors never read as the red accent. 9.6:1 on surface.

terminal-output-success.$description: Landing terminal lines for completed actions such as login and logout. 12.1:1 on surface.

snow.$description: Winter season only. Body of the snow that settles on the landing terminal window, light enough to read as snow on page-background.

snow-shade.$description: Winter season only. Underside of the settled snow and the flakes that fall on page-background.

headline-md.$description: Post title. It is the top of the body heading scale, so body headings stay below it.

headline-sm.$description: Body heading for a vault `#`. About 1.13x apart from the next heading level. Wide screens also set levels apart by how far a heading hangs left, so size steps stay small.

title-sm.$description: Body heading for a vault `####`. The lowest sans heading; 18px keeps it larger than 16px bold body text.

body-prose.$description: Post body paragraphs and lists. Same size as body-md with looser leading, because Hangul fills its em box and a long paragraph is read line after line while body-md sits in one-line UI rows.

label-sm.$description: The uppercase mono label idiom. Values match what the components shipped as text-xs + tracking-widest, so text-label-sm renders identically.

code-block.$description: Multi-line code fence body. Same size as code-snippet with looser leading, because a fence is read line by line while an inline snippet sits in a prose line.

display-terminal-mobile.$description: Terminal prompt/body text on mobile viewports.

measure.$description: Maximum reading column width for prose. Note and post bodies cap at this so the line length stays readable at every viewport.

toc-min.$description: Minimum width of the table of contents panel. `--breakpoint-toc` (1220px) is derived from it. The reading column is centred, so both margins must hold this width plus a gutter on each side: measure + 2 × (this width + 2 gutters) = 1196px, about 1211px with the reserved scrollbar gutter, rounded up to 1220px. The table of contents is only shown where the margin can hold at least this much without covering the reading column.

toc-max.$description: Maximum width of the table of contents panel. The panel grows into the margin beside the reading column up to this width; past it the extra margin stays empty so the outline never reads as a second column.

margin-label.$description: Width of the column a page hangs in the left margin of the reading column: the archive year and the post detail back link. `--breakpoint-margin-label` (900px) is derived from it. The column is centred at the measure, so each margin must hold this width, a gutter and the 16px page padding: measure + 2 × (this width + gutter + 16px) = 876px, about 891px with the reserved scrollbar gutter, rounded up to 900px. Below that the label sits above the content it marks.

header.$description: Height of the sticky terminal header. Anything that must clear it — sticky rails, scroll-margin on anchor targets — offsets from this.
